summary: Seattle area resident, Caltech alumnus, software engineer with expertise in programming languages (particularly D and C++), compiler design, and computer science, enjoys building and working on mechanical systems (hotrods), strong advocate for free market principles, critical of government regulation, believes in the importance of organized thinking and problem-solving skills, has a background in aviation and aerospace engineering, enjoys reading and has a significant collection of books, has a family structure that includes a father who served in WWII and attended MIT, has a strong interest in technology and its historical development, and is critical of the education system's effectiveness in teaching practical skills.
